rows.grounds: locative of jala, place of immersion
instrumental indicating duration; compound of ekādaśa and ahan
compound of roga and hṛt, describing the resulting quality

items.question: What transformative effect does immersion in water for eleven days produce in a mantra?
premises: A mantra is placed in water.
The duration of immersion is eleven days.
items.inference: Immersion in water for eleven days transforms a mantra into a disease-destroying agent.
uncertainties: manuḥ is glossed as mantra in this ritual context, though it can also mean a human or sage.
items.plain_english: And in water, within eleven days, the mantra becomes disease-destroying.
